question: Are the 5 previously verified strict sign reversals under acoustic+visual restriction supported across all original 27 site-deletion checks, or driven by individual influential sites? Extend the same check across all 15 fixed method panels.

source.study: Wenner et al. (2025), Global Ecology and Conservation 62 e03837; native data Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.15044115, CC BY 4.0

fixed_design.sites: Original Q1 27 sites, excluding kis-banyato and vadasz-turjan: 13 intervention, 6 control, 8 artificial; all 27 unique native site IDs, remove each exactly once
fixed_design.source_observation: site×species source-positive if any original recorded row has species count>0; four method positive witness sets source-authenticated as in lattice v1
fixed_design.method_panels: ALL 15 previously fixed nonempty subsets of acoustic, visual, dipnet, bottletrap (4 singles, 6 pairs, 4 triples, 1 all)
fixed_design.site_drop: exactly one original site removed for each held-out case; keep source species and method detections unaltered at remaining sites; decrement only that site's category denominator
fixed_design.contrasts: 9 species × intervention−control, intervention−artificial, artificial−control (27 per panel and site drop), exact cross-product sign from site-positive counts, not a fitted model
fixed_design.matched_baseline: for every leave-one-site-out scenario compare method-restricted subset against ALL-METHOD source support on SAME 26 retained sites, not against the original full-27 baseline
fixed_design.baseline_27: also preserve previous 15-panel full-27 signs and 5 AV sign reversals as regression checks

fixed_endpoints: 15 panels ×27 held-out site IDs ×27 category comparisons =10935 contrast outcome rows including full-method signs, subset signs and tie transitions

for each of the original five AV strict reversal contrasts, count the site deletions (of 27) where the exact strict reversal persists, disappears to a tie, or same-sign; group-specific deletion breakdown
for every method panel: min/median/max strict sign reversals over 27 site deletions, number of deleted-site scenarios with at least one and with zero strict reversals, contrast-level site sensitivity
for original full-method baseline itself: number of 27 site deletions where baseline sign changes (excluding tied transitions), explicitly separate from method reversal persistence
for each original full-27 strict reversal: zero/tie sensitivity; do not classify any tie as sign reversal
full four-method panel must have zero method-induced sign reversals in all deleted-site checks, AV complete full-27 regression exactly five, all source site/method mask and site roster SHA checks
machine-readable complete per-contrast CSV, per-panel-by-site summary CSV, per-original-five persistence summary CSV, fixed result fingerprint
inference_limits: This is repeated deterministic leave-one-source-site-out sensitivity of an observed 27-site study; 27 leave-one-out outcomes are not independent field replications, CIs, p-values, or permutation tests.
Small group denominators are 13,6,8 before site removal and 12/13,5/6,7/8 after; sign flips may reflect tiny margins and category effort differences.

Method recording coverage/detection effort and seasonal closure remain unverified; missing source method row does not prove method not deployed, and 0 in a subset cannot mean confirmed biological absence.
Site deletion analyses support only robustness of descriptive source-record positivity contrasts and no causal restoration, abiotic/biotic/movement A/B/M, occupancy or EOG-WF superiority claims.
Do not modify frozen EOG-WF 3/31/3 endpoint accounting, author source data, or merge Draft PR #697.
